title: Free Resume Builder for Freshers: Build an ATS-Optimized Tech Resume in 5 Minutes
description: How fresh engineering graduates can generate free, ATS-friendly LaTeX tech resumes with quantified project bullets and verified skills.

image.alt: Free Resume Builder for Freshers Workflow

body:
Campus placement drives and off-campus tech applications require a clean, ATS-compliant resume that clearly displays your core competencies, coding projects, and educational background without distracting formatting errors. InternFlow provides freshers with a 100% free resume builder powered by LaTeX and AI.

## 1. Step-by-Step Fresher Resume Building

- Connect Your GitHub Profile: Automatically import your repositories, commit statistics, and verified technologies.
- Select a Standardized 1-Page Layout: Proven templates that ensure high ATS readability across Workday, Greenhouse, and Lever.
- Generate Quantified Bullets: Turn raw repository code into professional impact statements using the Google XYZ formula.
- Download Clean PDF: Export instantly with zero watermarks, subscription trials, or hidden fees.

## 2. Essential Sections for Freshers

1. Contact Information & Links (GitHub, LinkedIn, Portfolio)
2. Education & Relevant Coursework (DSA, OS, DBMS, Networks)
3. Technical Skills Categorized (Languages, Frameworks, Databases, Tools)
4. Flagship Projects with Live Links and Metrics
5. Hackathons, Certifications & Achievements

faq.q: Is InternFlow's resume builder completely free for freshers?
faq.a: Yes! You can build, edit, score, and download your ATS-ready resume in PDF format completely free without entering a credit card.
